podcast.body: This song was recorded in March 1980 at Electric Lady Studios for the "Sandinista!" album. The band was working downstairs while The Rolling Stones were recording "Emotional Rescue" upstairs, and the track features early rap influences, which Joe Strummer picked up during his time in New York. "The clash and the magnificent seven. The magnificent song. The clash from Sandinista and the magnificent seven recorded at Jimmy Hendrix's electric lady studios."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: This track from the *Sandinista!* album features Joe Strummer's "credible attempt at rapping." Released in 1980, it showcases how "in touch" Joe and The Clash were with nascent street music trends, at a time when rap was so new that "hardly anyone knew about it" outside of a few releases by artists like the Sugarhill Gang and Kurtis Blow.

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
